I'll read both texts carefully, hunting for signature losses.

**Key signatures I'm tracking:**

1. "The classification of the constituents of a chaos, nothing less is here essayed." — rhetorically distinctive
2. The full list of authors (Bible through Rev. T. Cheever) — interpretive weight, voice
3. The "This is Charing Cross; hear ye!" passage — present in draft ✓
4. "the sperm whale, scientific or poetic, lives not complete in any literature. Far above all other hunted whales, his is an unwritten life." — draft has this ✓
5. "I promise nothing complete; because any human thing supposed to be complete, must for that very reason infallibly be faulty." — draft has this ✓
6. "I am the architect, not the builder." — present ✓
7. The Job passage ("Will he make a covenant with thee?") — present ✓
8. "I have swam through libraries and sailed through oceans" — present ✓
9. Simeon Macey and Charley Coffin / "Charley profanely hinted they were humbug" — present ✓
10. "a whale is a spouting fish with a horizontal tail" — present ✓
11. Fin-Back as "banished and unconquerable Cain of his race" — draft has "a Cain among whales" — compressed but recognizable
12. The Cologne Cathedral closing — present ✓
13. "God keep me from ever completing anything. This whole book is but a draught—nay, but the draught of a draught. Oh, Time, Strength, Cash, and Patience!" — present ✓
14. The full author list — MISSING
15. "On this rock every one of the whale-naturalists has split." — present ✓
16. The Narwhale / Queen Bess / Frobisher passage — compressed but present
17. "For we are all killers, on land and on sea; Bonapartes and Sharks included." — present ✓
18. Pig-fish/Dugongs footnote passage — compressed
19. The Huzza Porpoise "if you yourself can withstand three cheers" passage — absent

Now let me assess the author list closely. The source has a long, specific list from "Authors of the Bible; Aristotle; Pliny; Aldrovandi; Sir Thomas Browne; Gesner; Ray; Linnæus; Rondeletius; Willoughby; Green; Artedi; Sibbald; Brisson; Marten; Lacépède; Bonneterre; Desmarest; Baron Cuvier; Frederick Cuvier; John Hunter; Owen; Scoresby; Beale; Bennett; J. Ross Browne; the Author of Miriam Coffin; Olmstead; and the Rev. T. Cheever." This is a distinctive enumerative rhetorical device and critically noted — the draft reduces it to "from the Authors of the Bible and Aristotle, down to Scoresby, Beale, and Bennett." This is a significant loss of voice and textual distinctiveness.

The "Fin-Back as the banished and unconquerable Cain" — source: "this leviathan seems the banished and unconquerable Cain of his race, bearing for his mark that style upon his back." Draft has "a Cain among whales" — the full interpretive weight ("banished and unconquerable," "bearing for his mark") is flattened.

"If you yourself can withstand three cheers at beholding these vivacious fish, then heaven help ye; the spirit of godly gamesomeness is not in ye." — absent from draft.

The Lamatins/Dugongs footnote with "noisy, contemptible set, mostly lurking in the mouths of rivers, and feeding on wet hay" — voice-defining satirical wit, reduced to mere "they do not spout."

The detailed Linnæus grounds passage — "penem intrantem feminam mammis lactantem" — draft compresses this substantially; the comic effect of submitting the Latin to Nantucket fishermen is preserved but abbreviated.
